# Mutation testing varies each dynamic and control flow action in a template
# and re-runs the tests. A mutation the tests still pass through is a miss:
# nothing asserts on the behaviour that action controls.
#
# Here TestGreeting renders with Loud false and compares the whole string, so
# it catches the {{.Name}} action and catches forcing {{if .Loud}} true. It
# never renders with Loud true, so forcing the branch false changes nothing it
# observes, and that mutant survives.

muxt test-template-mutations
cmp stdout want.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{if .Loud}} !!!{{end}}{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Greeting struct {
	Name string
	Loud bool
}
-- render_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGreeting(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := templates.ExecuteTemplate(&buf, "greeting", Greeting{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "Hello, World!"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("greeting = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- want.txt --
baseline ok
KILL templates.gohtml:1:31 "greeting" action-empty
MISS templates.gohtml:1:44 "greeting" if-false
KILL templates.gohtml:1:44 "greeting" if-true
3 mutants, 2 killed, 1 missed
